newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES RALLY STRONGLY.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK - LOCAL SHARES RALLY STRONGLY.

text.p: The domestic market rose strongly
over the week to close 8.77 points up at 439.49.
Barclays registered a 35 thebe gain to close at 730
thebe on the back of strong institutional and private demand.
Oil company Engen traded up 10 at 445, clothing chain
Pep rose five to 300.
Brewery Holding Company Sechaba continued its
recent strong run by putting on another five thebe to close at
320 and Standard Chartered also increased by five to
Trading unchanged were Botswana Insurance at 220,
First National at 500, food and tobacco wholesaler
Metsef at 645, milling company and food wholesaler
Sefalana at 430 and variable loan stock company RDC
Properties moving a large block at 170.
Untraded were security group Inco , bids only at 90,
and investment company Kgola ya Sechaba , 180/190.
Volume and value were down over the week with 363,180
(514,395) shares changing hands for value 1,015,062 pula
On the foreign, dual listed, board, there was interest in
car rental and fleet management group Avis which put on
nine thebe over the week to 602 and De Beers, up 67 to
McCarthy Retail group and Regent Undervalued Assets
Fund were untraded. Regent closed unchanged at 4,000
and McCarthy shed eight to 1,143t.
Turnover was 1,300 shares. The foreign index closed 1.96
points up at 394.10 and the all companies index 2.14 points up
